description: This file defines a class 'WithTokenParser' within the Twig templating engine, responsible for parsing the 'with' tag that creates nested scopes in templates.

classes.name: WithTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser that handles parsing of the 'with' tag in Twig templates, creating nested variable scopes.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'with' tag in a Twig template, extracting variables and body content, and returning a WithNode object.

methods.name: decideWithEnd
methods.description: Decision callback to determine if the end of the 'with' block has been reached based on the 'endwith' token.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'with' associated with this token parser.
